consuming_workflow: Contributors admit, claim, revise and verify governed work through existing CLI, selector, hook and separately reviewed exact promotion.
intent: Permit legitimate bounded owner-directed corrections while preserving review, source authority, ownership and product acceptance boundaries.
scope: Eight required scenario groups and all individual variants, with actual observed entry-point behavior and protected state.
exclusions: No Preferences implementation or acceptance, prototype edits, dependencies or invented authority; no claim to prevent arbitrary off-repository writes. Promotion mutation has its separate exact owner-reviewed packet.

units_precision.reason: No CAD geometry or unit conversion; control IDs and hashes are not CAD precision.

numeric_entry.reason: No CAD numeric entry; malformed control values are separately tested as validation inputs.

selection_identity.reason: No CAD selection or stable design subject; Frontier identity is control authority, not product selection.

grid_snap.reason: No authored or snapped coordinate, grid setting or editor consumer.

undo_cancel.reason: Refusal and interruption preserve state; no design undo capability is claimed.

persistence_recovery.reason: Protected source/index/refs/trust survive refusal and interruption; a fresh invocation succeeds. No native Save claim.

library_connectivity.reason: No authored library binding, net or connectivity model.

settings_scope.reason: Read only explicitly selected repository-local trust and requested snapshot; no Global Preferences acceptance.

consumers.scope: Explicit isolated repository, externally selected trust and requested snapshot only.
consumers.timing: Validate before reporting a permitted transition; return actual findings without repairing inputs.
consumers.persistence: Read-only protected repository state; owned diagnostic logs and derived caches recorded separately.
consumers.unavailable_reason: Missing or inconsistent authority, inputs or evidence refuses. Early hook trust or prerequisite failures may precede validator dispatch and JSON; retain the actual diagnostic and uninvoked handler, never a fabricated success.
